QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_26

answer.text: DPI + RVPI (cumulative distributions plus residual value, divided by paid-in capital)

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 9.7.4.4: TVPI = (Cumulative Distributions + Residual Value) / PIC = DPI + RVPI. The 'Net Multiple'. It measures total value created. Equals MOIC when all capital is called. The Trap: Option A multiplies them incorrectly. Option B subtracts instead of adds. Option D is unrelated. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B tests TVPI = DPI + RVPI; XXI-B similar. Manager's Pro-Tip: When TVPI >> (DPI + RVPI reconciliation), investigate valuation assumptions or FX translation. A consistently large MOIC-to-RVPI ratio is a red flag — Ch 9 explicitly warns on this for valuation integrity.
